item.text: To book a room, first submit the dates and times you would like to use it. The booking team will then check whether the room is available. After receiving your request, they will send you a confirmation that it was received. Please note that this confirmation only means your request is being processed—it does not mean your booking has been approved. You should wait for a separate message confirming that the room is reserved for you.
